My research is on **Generalized Ordinary Differential Equations**, **Generalized Stochastic Equations**, **stability theory**, with applications to **measure functional Volterra–Stieltjes integral equations**, **interactive fuzzy differential equations**, and their relation with **non-linear dynamical systems**.
